title: TicketLens
highlights: Fine-tuned DistilBERT for 27-intent support-ticket routing, reaching 99.84% accuracy and 0.998 macro-F1 on 2,464 held-out messages in 172s on a laptop GPU.
Benchmarked TF-IDF, frozen MiniLM embeddings and fine-tuned DistilBERT on a deduplicated, stratified split — a 1 MB TF-IDF model within 0.5 points of the transformer.
Compared BART, Flan-T5 and a lead-2 baseline for dialogue summarization with ROUGE and BERTScore; Flan-T5-base led (ROUGE-L 0.259 vs 0.222).
